bread-omelette.title: Vegetable bread omelette
bread-omelette.recipe:
1. Beat 2 eggs with 25 g chopped onion, 50 g tomato, 25 g capsicum, coriander, black pepper and salt.
2. Heat 1 tsp oil in a pan, pour in the eggs and place 2 slices of whole-wheat bread (60 g total) on top. Flip, cook until the egg is fully set, then fold into a sandwich.

paneer-moong-chilla.title: Paneer-stuffed moong chilla
paneer-moong-chilla.recipe:
1. Soak 60 g dry moong dal until softened. Drain and blend with 40 g onion, ginger, cumin, salt and enough water for a pourable batter.
2. Crumble 50 g low-fat paneer and mix with coriander and roasted, ground cumin.
3. Make 2 chillas in a non-stick pan using 1 tsp oil in total. Cook both sides, add the paneer filling and fold.

paneer-paratha.title: Paneer paratha
paneer-paratha.recipe:
1. Knead 60 g atta with water and a pinch of salt. Mix 75 g crumbled low-fat paneer with 30 g finely chopped onion, coriander and roasted, ground cumin.
2. Stuff and roll 2 small parathas. Cook both sides on a tawa using 1 tsp oil in total.

green-juice.title: Green juice
green-juice.recipe: Blend 100 g cucumber, 100 g apple, a few mint leaves, a small piece of ginger and a squeeze of lemon with enough water to make a glass. Serve fresh.

paneer-bhurji.title: Paneer bhurji, phulka & cucumber salad
paneer-bhurji.recipe:
1. Heat 3 tsp oil with cumin. Cook 100 g onion, 200 g tomato and 100 g capsicum with turmeric, coriander powder and salt. Fold in 250 g crumbled low-fat paneer and heat through.
2. Make 4 small phulkas from 100 g atta and water. Serve with 200 g cucumber, lemon and coriander.

lemon-chicken.title: Lemon-garlic chicken, vegetables & potato wedges
lemon-chicken.recipe:
1. Coat 320 g boneless, skinless chicken breast with garlic, lemon, oregano, black pepper, salt and 1 tsp oil. Pan-cook until the centre reaches 74°C.
2. Parboil 400 g potato wedges until nearly tender. Toss with 1 tsp oil and air-fry in a single layer until browned.
3. Sauté 200 g carrot, 200 g green beans and 100 g capsicum in 1 tsp oil, adding a splash of water to soften. Serve together.

palak-chicken.title: Palak chicken & phulka
palak-chicken.recipe:
1. Blanch 300 g spinach and blend. Heat 2 tsp oil with cumin; cook 100 g onion, 200 g tomato, ginger, garlic, turmeric, coriander powder and salt.
2. Add 320 g boneless, skinless chicken breast, 100 g plain curd and a splash of water. Simmer until the chicken reaches 74°C, then stir in the spinach and garam masala and heat through.
3. Serve with 4 small phulkas made from 100 g atta and water.

tofu-stir-fry.title: Tofu & vegetable stir-fry with rice
tofu-stir-fry.recipe:
1. Cook 90 g rice. Pat dry and cube 400 g firm tofu.
2. Heat 2 tsp oil in a non-stick pan and brown the tofu. Add garlic, ginger, 200 g cabbage, 200 g carrot and 200 g capsicum; stir-fry until just tender.
3. Toss with 2 tsp soy sauce, 2 tsp vinegar and a splash of water. Add 30 g crushed roasted peanuts and serve over the rice.

dal-palak.title: Dal palak, phulka & cucumber raita
dal-palak.recipe:
1. Rinse 140 g moong dal and simmer in water with turmeric until soft. Add 300 g chopped spinach and cook through.
2. Heat 2 tsp oil with cumin and garlic, cook 100 g chopped onion, then stir into the dal with salt.
3. Mix 300 g plain curd with 200 g cucumber and roasted, ground cumin. Serve with the dal and 2 phulkas made from 70 g atta and water.

chicken-fajita-bowl.title: Chicken fajita rice bowl
chicken-fajita-bowl.recipe:
1. Cook 100 g rice. Cut 320 g boneless, skinless chicken breast into strips and coat with garlic, ground cumin, oregano, lemon and salt.
2. Heat 2 tsp oil and cook the chicken to 74°C. Add 200 g capsicum and 100 g onion; toss until tender.
3. Chop 300 g tomato and mix with coriander and lemon for salsa. Serve the chicken, vegetables and salsa over the rice.

rajma-rice.title: Rajma rice & cucumber raita
rajma-rice.recipe:
1. Use 400 g fully cooked rajma. Heat 2 tsp oil with cumin; cook 100 g onion, 200 g tomato, ginger, garlic, turmeric, coriander powder, garam masala and salt. Add the rajma and water; simmer into a thick curry.
2. Cook 60 g rice. Mix 300 g plain curd with 200 g cucumber and roasted, ground cumin. Serve together.

chicken-tomato-pasta.title: Chicken tomato pasta
chicken-tomato-pasta.recipe:
1. Boil 110 g egg-free whole-wheat pasta in salted water; reserve a little cooking water.
2. Heat 2 tsp oil and brown 320 g diced boneless, skinless chicken breast. Add garlic, 100 g onion and 200 g capsicum; cook until softened.
3. Add 300 g finely chopped tomato, oregano, black pepper and salt. Simmer until saucy and the chicken reaches 74°C. Toss in the pasta, loosening with the reserved water.

matar-paneer.title: Matar paneer & phulka
matar-paneer.recipe:
1. Heat 2 tsp oil with cumin. Cook 100 g onion, 300 g tomato, ginger, garlic, turmeric, coriander powder and salt; blend with a splash of water.
2. Return to the pan, add 200 g peas and simmer until tender. Add 250 g cubed low-fat paneer and garam masala; heat through.
3. Serve with 4 small phulkas made from 80 g atta and water.

chicken-noodles.title: Chicken & vegetable noodles
chicken-noodles.recipe:
1. Boil 110 g egg-free whole-wheat noodles according to the packet and drain.
2. Heat 2 tsp oil with garlic and ginger. Add 320 g thinly sliced boneless, skinless chicken breast and cook to 74°C.
3. Add 300 g cabbage, 150 g carrot and 150 g capsicum; stir-fry until just tender. Toss with the noodles, 2 tsp soy sauce, 2 tsp vinegar and black pepper.

paneer-wrap.title: Paneer & vegetable curd wraps
paneer-wrap.recipe:
1. Make 4 phulkas from 100 g atta and water. Toss 250 g crumbled low-fat paneer in a pan with 2 tsp oil, ground cumin and salt; let cool slightly.
2. Mix 200 g thick plain curd with garlic, lemon and coriander. Fold in the paneer, 200 g cucumber, 100 g grated carrot and 100 g finely shredded cabbage.
3. Divide the filling between the phulkas, roll and serve.

roast-chicken.title: Pan-roasted chicken, vegetables & toast
roast-chicken.recipe:
1. Coat 320 g boneless, skinless chicken breast in 100 g plain curd, ginger, garlic, ground cumin, coriander powder, salt and 1 tsp oil. Pan-roast until the centre reaches 74°C.
2. Sauté 200 g carrot, 200 g green beans and 200 g capsicum with 1 tsp oil and a splash of water until tender. Finish with lemon.
3. Serve with 140 g toasted egg-free whole-wheat bread.

chicken-pulao.title: Chicken & vegetable pulao with raita
chicken-pulao.recipe:
1. Heat 2 tsp oil with cumin, cinnamon and bay leaf. Cook 100 g onion with ginger and garlic. Add 320 g diced boneless, skinless chicken breast, 100 g carrot and salt; cook until the chicken changes colour.
2. Add 80 g rinsed rice, 120 g peas and about 200 ml water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 74°C, adding water if needed.
3. Mix 300 g plain curd with 200 g cucumber and roasted, ground cumin. Serve alongside the pulao.

chickpea-paneer-salad.title: Warm chickpea & paneer salad with toast
chickpea-paneer-salad.recipe:
1. Heat 2 tsp oil with cumin and garlic. Add 100 g onion, 200 g capsicum and 200 g cubed low-fat paneer; toss until lightly coloured.
2. Add 250 g fully cooked chickpeas and 200 g tomato. Toss until warm, then finish with lemon, coriander, chaat masala and salt.
3. Serve with 2 slices of toasted egg-free whole-wheat bread (60 g total).

koshimbir.title: Cucumber-carrot koshimbir
koshimbir.recipe: Mix 400 g plain curd with 200 g chopped cucumber, 200 g grated carrot, 30 g crushed roasted peanuts and salt. Heat 1 tsp oil with mustard seeds, cumin and curry leaves; pour over the salad and mix.

chana-chaat.title: Dahi chana chaat
chana-chaat.recipe: Toss 250 g fully cooked chickpeas with 100 g cucumber, 100 g tomato, coriander, lemon, chaat masala and roasted, ground cumin. Fold through 200 g plain curd and serve.

paneer-salad.title: Paneer, cucumber & carrot salad
paneer-salad.recipe: Toss 160 g cubed low-fat paneer with 200 g cucumber, 200 g grated carrot and 30 g crushed roasted peanuts. Dress with lemon, coriander, roasted, ground cumin and salt.

guava-chana-chaat.title: Guava & roasted chana chaat
guava-chana-chaat.recipe: Chop 300 g guava and 200 g cucumber. Toss with 70 g roasted chana, 10 g crushed roasted peanuts, lemon and chaat masala. Serve immediately so the chana stays crunchy.
